text:
ELIGIBLE-SET CARRIER: DESIGN WORKED OUT NOW SO IMPLEMENTATION IS FAST WHEN 0ca09c5 LANDS. Read-only,
nothing edited, no candidate. Posting rather than sitting idle - batch 1 is fully staffed and I
cannot start this without stacking on my own unlanded leg.

IT CLOSES A LOOP FROM THIS MORNING, which I had not connected until I went looking. At ~11:00 you
asked me to re-derive the enforceability law after eligible-set scaling landed. I answered that the
invariant which actually holds is CONTAINMENT - present must be a subset of eligible - and then had
to tell you it was NOT EXTERNALLY OBSERVABLE, because `eligible` is computed inside cost() and
discarded; only the derived ratio survives as supportWeight. Verified again just now: AlignWire has
exactly two subsetOf checks, MayBeMissing and HasReductionReceipt. There is no containment check
because there is nothing to check it against.

CARRYING THE SET MAKES THAT LAW ENFORCEABLE AT THE WIRE. That is a third independent motivation, on
top of your two:
  1. the trace's fourth case (Ineligible), ruled on Proposal C part 3
  2. the external-row comparison - support 1.0 meaning "nothing was eligible" while arguing for the
     intrusion
  3. containment becomes checkable: `terms.keySet subsetOf eligible`, which is exactly the defect
     that discounted segment cells 14.9% this afternoon and which no law can currently catch.
Three motivations for one Set[CostTerm] is stronger than the two you had.

WHAT IT FIXES ON THE EXTERNAL ROW, concretely. supportOf returns 1.0 from `if eligible.isEmpty then
1.0` (cost.scala:755 and 767). So today:
  ext:Intrusion   support 1.000, eligible unknown -> reads as "nothing was assumed"
  source cell     support 0.955, eligible unknown -> reads as weaker
With the set carried, the same two rows read:
  ext:Intrusion   support 1.000, eligible = {}            -> nothing was ELIGIBLE
  source cell     support 0.955, eligible = {5 terms}     -> nearly everything eligible was measured
A consumer can then refuse to compare them, which is what the carrier was built for.

THE ONE DESIGN QUESTION I WOULD PUT TO YOU, and I am not deciding it: should supportOf keep
returning 1.0 for empty eligibility, now that the empty case is distinguishable? Keeping it is
defensible - "nothing eligible went unmeasured" is literally true - and your instinct that "the fix
is not a different number" points that way. But the pair (1.0, {}) still SORTS as the best-supported
row in any consumer that reads only the scalar, and there will be such consumers. The alternative is
that supportWeight becomes Option or a small ADT, which is a wider change than one field. My lean is
KEEP 1.0 AND CARRY THE SET, because renumbering hides the case the set is there to reveal - the
same reason I stopped the earlier attempt that defaulted empty eligibility to all terms and
collapsed every row to External.

COST, stated up front: another required wire field, so hsmm/v4 and a second golden re-cut within a
day of v3. Same argument as before - I do not think it should be folded into 0ca09c5 to save a bump,
because that would invalidate a review on bytes already read.

Not starting until 0ca09c5 is in. If you would rather this go to someone else so I stay on the
placement/coordinate reviews, say so - it is my bead but it is not my property.
